products.name: D-ID
products.note: Talking head AI; photo animation; likeness rights; deepfake risk; Israeli vendor

profile_text.body:
D-ID is an Israeli company that provides an AI-powered video creation platform built around digital humans and talking avatars. The company describes itself as the top choice for AI-generated video and offers a self-service product called Creative Reality Studio, which combines deep-learning face animation, large language model text generation, and text-to-image capabilities to let users produce videos featuring moving, lip-synced avatars. The platform supports voice cloning and multilingual output, and is positioned for use cases including marketing, corporate training, sales enablement, and customer support.

D-ID also promotes a product it calls NUI, or Natural User Interface, which it describes as aimed at changing how people interact with digital content through AI. Its API allows third parties to build avatar-based video features into their own applications, and the company lists integrations with Microsoft PowerPoint, Canva, and Google Slides. Clients mentioned on the site include Grupo Fórmula and its subsidiaries TVOAI and Radio Formula, where D-ID technology has been used for media content in Mexico and Latin America.

The site's held facts classify D-ID under video generation and editing, noting its focus on talking-head AI, photo animation, likeness rights, and deepfake risk considerations. No litigation, patent filings, SEC records, or MCP server registrations are present in the available data.
